snippet.description:
Introducing the Prelims Master Program (PMP) 2027 by LevelUp IAS — a complete UPSC Prelims system designed to help aspirants build conceptual clarity, revise systematically, and perform confidently in the Civil Services Examination.

Starting 23 November 2026, PMP 2027 brings together General Studies, CSAT, and Current Affairs Updates in one integrated preparation program

Enroll in Prelims Master Program 2027: https://shorturl.at/YvX9J

What does PMP 2027 include?

- 70+ focused GS lectures covering the Prelims-relevant syllabus in a structured, time-bound schedule.
- PYQ-based learning with relevant previous years’ questions integrated into classroom discussions.
- Command Prelims Notes — compact, revision-friendly study handouts.
- 80+ practice tests, including GS and CSAT mini tests, full-length tests, and Pre-Samiksha All India Open Mock Tests.
- Dedicated CSAT preparation with 45 classes covering Quantitative Aptitude, Logical Reasoning, and Reading Comprehension.
- Current Affairs Updates with dedicated notes and classes covering relevant developments through 23 April 2027.
- Weekly mentorship and strategy session with Santosh Sir to help students plan preparation and address challenges.

PMP follows a structured learning cycle: Learn → Practise → Revise → Perform. Through classes, notes, PYQs, regular tests, and revision, the program aims to help aspirants build the consistency and exam readiness required for UPSC Prelims.

Start Your UPSC Prelims 2027 Preparation with PMP
Make your preparation more structured with expert-led classes, regular practice tests, revision support, and mentorship.

PMP 2027 starts on 23 November 2026. Enrol now and secure your seat.

👉 Explore the program and enrol: https://shorturl.at/YvX9J

📞 Call for admission enquiries: 88264 96658

Offline seats are limited. Apply early to secure your preferred batch.

PMP Faculty

- Vivek Singh Sir — Indian Economy
- G. Babu Sir — Polity
- Akhilesh Sir — Geography
- Nikhil Seth Sir — Ancient, Medieval History & Art and Culture (AMAC)
- Vishal Sir — Modern History
- Himanshi Ma’am — CSAT
- Santosh Sir — Science & Technology, Environment, International Bodies, International Mapping, and Current Affairs Updates

#upsc  #upscprelims2027  #PrelimsMasterProgram #PMP2027 #upscpreparation  #upscprelims  #upscmocktest  #csat  #currentaffairs  #levelupias
